firm_data.firm_description: DOPF, P.C. is a defense litigation firm in New York, handling a wide range of personal injury defense work. They are known for their willingness to bring cases to trial and verdict.
notable_facts: Ranked by U.S. News and World Report as a Tier 1 Medical Malpractice Law Best Law Firm for 2017.
Partners Glenn Dopf and Joseph Cammarosano have been named to New York Magazine's list of "Best Lawyers."

email.subject: AI for DOPF, P.C. - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Glenn,

Your U.S. News and World Report Tier 1 ranking in Medical Malpractice Litigation speaks to the caliber of work DOPF handles. With a willingness to take cases to trial and verdict across construction, medical device, and malpractice defense, you've built something most firms struggle with: credibility through conviction.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
